title: Royalty Crowns
description: Renaming a carved pumkin will turn it into different kinds of crowns
body:
This resource pack adds different kinds of crowns _(currently only one available)_ via renaming a carved pumkin in an anvil.

Inorder to acquired a specific crown model, rename the craved pumkin to the corresponding **crown's name** (the crowns' name will be shown in the gallery tab).
